summary: The main article describes a photoredox/HAT dual-catalyzed carboxylation of benzyl chlorides using CO2, sodium thiophenolate, and potassium formate. The document includes optimization tables, substrate scope schemes, and mechanistic studies including kinetic and control experiments.
